description: 30 realistic human-language test cases for autonomous tool calling across exploration, editing, file creation, multi-step features, and diagnostics.

tests.title: Explore mathematical functions in calculator
tests.human_message: Where are the mathematical functions defined in the calculator project and what operations are supported?
tests.expected_behavior: Agent explores src/App.jsx, identifies handleScientific, and summarizes sin, cos, tan, sqrt, sqr, log, ln, pi, e operations.

tests.title: Understand snake game loop and collision detection
tests.human_message: Can you explain how the snake game's main loop and collision detection work?
tests.expected_behavior: Agent reads src/App.jsx and explains the setInterval timer, boundary checks against GRID_SIZE, and self-collision checks.

tests.title: Inspect calculator dependencies
tests.human_message: What dependencies does the calculator app rely on and what versions are installed?
tests.expected_behavior: Agent inspects package.json and lists react, react-dom, @vitejs/plugin-react, and vite.

tests.title: Examine Web Audio sound synthesis
tests.human_message: Show me how the audio sound effects are synthesized in the snake game.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent locates playSound in src/App.jsx and explains the oscillator, frequency ramping, and gain envelope for eat, die, and turn.

tests.title: Find keyboard event handlers in calculator
tests.human_message: Find all places in the calculator where user keyboard events are handled.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent identifies handleKeyDown and the window keydown event listener in src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Inspect high score persistence in snake game
tests.human_message: How is the high score saved and retrieved across browser reloads in the snake game?
tests.expected_behavior: Agent identifies localStorage.getItem('cyber_snake_high') and localStorage.setItem calls in src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Change default calculator theme
tests.human_message: In the calculator, change the default theme from cyan to emerald so it loads in green mode.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent surgically updates useState('cyan') to useState('emerald') in src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Increase initial snake speed
tests.human_message: Update the snake game's starting speed from 110ms to 90ms so it starts faster and feels more challenging.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent replaces speed 110 with 90 in useState and startGame() inside src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Boost golden fruit reward points
tests.human_message: Change the golden food points in the snake game from 25 points to 50 points.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent finds food.type === 'golden' ? 25 : 10 and updates 25 to 50 in src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Add keyboard clear shortcut 'c'
tests.human_message: In the calculator, make pressing 'c' or 'C' on the keyboard clear the screen just like the Escape key does.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent updates handleKeyDown to trigger handleClear() when e.key is 'c' or 'C'.

tests.title: Expand calculation history capacity
tests.human_message: Increase the calculator's history limit so it remembers up to 50 previous calculations instead of 20.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent modifies .slice(0, 19) to .slice(0, 49) in handleCalculate.

tests.title: Customize snake head corner radius
tests.human_message: In the snake game canvas renderer, make the snake's head rounder by increasing its corner radius to 8px.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent changes roundRect corner radius for isHead from 6 to 8 in src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Change game over headline
tests.human_message: Change the game over heading text from 'SYSTEM CRASH' to 'NEON OVERLOAD'.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent replaces 'SYSTEM CRASH' with 'NEON OVERLOAD' in the game over modal.

tests.title: Add cube (x³) button to scientific panel
tests.human_message: Add a cube (x³) button to the calculator's scientific mode panel that multiplies the current number by itself three times.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent adds 'cube' case in handleScientific (num * num * num) and adds the corresponding button to JSX.

tests.title: Increase snake playing grid size
tests.human_message: Enlarge the snake grid from 22 to 24 cells for a slightly bigger arena.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent updates GRID_SIZE constant from 22 to 24 in src/App.jsx.

tests.title: Allow Enter key to restart snake game
tests.human_message: Ensure pressing Enter or Spacebar on the Game Over screen instantly restarts the game.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent verifies and updates keydown listener for gameState === 'GAMEOVER'.

tests.title: Create audio constants module
tests.human_message: Create a new file src/audio_constants.js in the snake game project exporting frequency and timing configurations for game sounds.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent creates src/audio_constants.js with structured sound parameters for eat, die, turn, and levelup.

tests.title: Create theme definitions JSON
tests.human_message: Create a new JSON configuration file src/themes.json in the calculator project listing custom color palettes for neon, cyber, and obsidian.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent writes src/themes.json with valid schema and color hex codes.

tests.title: Create pure math helper module
tests.human_message: Create a pure utility file src/math_utils.js with helper functions for add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, and factorial.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent creates src/math_utils.js exporting functions with clean error handling (like divide by zero).

tests.title: Write CONTRIBUTING guide for snake game
tests.human_message: Create a CONTRIBUTING.md in the snake game directory explaining the project structure and how to add new power-up fruits.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent writes comprehensive markdown file documenting codebase architecture and extension points.

tests.title: Create dedicated storage helper module
tests.human_message: Create src/storage.js in the snake game to encapsulate localStorage reads and writes with try/catch fallbacks.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent creates src/storage.js with getHighScore and saveHighScore helper functions.

tests.title: Create key bindings map module
tests.human_message: Create src/keybindings.js in the calculator project mapping keyboard key strings to calculator actions.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent writes src/keybindings.js with lookup dictionary for digits, operators, and control keys.

tests.title: Add Audio Mute Toggle to Snake Game
tests.human_message: Please add a sound toggle button (Mute / Unmute) to the snake game header HUD and update playSound to honor it.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent introduces isMuted state, adds a toggle button in the HUD, and checks !isMuted before triggering AudioContext.

tests.title: Add Memory (MS, MR, MC) keys to Calculator
tests.human_message: Add Memory Store (MS), Memory Recall (MR), and Memory Clear (MC) buttons to the calculator with state tracking.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent adds memory state (number or null), handlers for MS, MR, MC, and renders memory keys in the UI.

tests.title: Add Freeze Power-Up to Snake Game
tests.human_message: Add an icy blue 'freeze' power-up fruit that spawns occasionally and slows down the snake speed for 5 seconds.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent adds 'freeze' food type, handles blue particle rendering, and temporarily modifies speed state with a timeout.

tests.title: Add Export Calculation History feature
tests.human_message: Add an 'Export History' button to the calculation log panel that copies all past calculations formatted as markdown to the clipboard.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent formats history array into markdown lines, calls navigator.clipboard.writeText, and shows a toast.

tests.title: Add Difficulty Selector to Snake Game
tests.human_message: Add a difficulty picker on the Snake start screen with options: Casual (140ms), Cyber (100ms), and Hyperdrive (65ms).
tests.expected_behavior: Agent adds difficulty selection state, renders difficulty buttons in start overlay, and initializes speed accordingly.

tests.title: Check and fix lint/syntax in calculator
tests.human_message: Inspect the calculator project source code to make sure there are no syntax errors, unclosed tags, or broken imports.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent inspects src/App.jsx, src/main.jsx, and index.html, confirming clean syntax.

tests.title: Prevent instant 180-degree self-collision in snake game
tests.human_message: Review changeDirection in the snake game to confirm that a player cannot immediately reverse direction into their own neck.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent reads changeDirection in src/App.jsx and validates the opposite direction guard logic.

tests.title: Implement multiply function in sample_project Rust crate
tests.human_message: In the sample_project Rust fixture, add a new public function 'multiply(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32' to src/lib.rs with a unit test.
tests.expected_behavior: Agent edits src/lib.rs to add pub fn multiply and adds a test_multiply unit test.
